text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Whew. I managed to come in first place.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, but this win is nothing special. It's merely the natural consequence of our daily efforts.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Our training must continue, and we should not grow complacent.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you. I didn't think you'd be this excited, though.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: However, this is only one stop on the way to the top. So please—continue on this journey with me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. One must wear one's helm most firmly in the moment of victory, as the saying goes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So please remain vigilant as you guide me forward. ♪
